title: Lip filler in Cairo
description: Explore lip filler and hydration in Cairo, including assessment of lip shape, early swelling, signs that need urgent care and how to ask for a personal quote.
answer: Lip filler places a gel in selected parts of the lips to adjust their outline or volume. It may suit adults looking for a subtle change in proportion. At {{brand}} in New Cairo and Mohandessin, the consultation covers lip hydration, previous filler and how swelling may affect the early result.
preparation: Tell us about cold sores, previous lip injections and any current swelling. An active infection needs assessment before treatment.
howPerformed: The team examines the lip border and movement, discusses hydration or volume, and places the chosen gel if appropriate.
followup: Swelling and bruising can disguise the initial shape. Review once these settle. Severe pain, pale or mottled skin or changes in vision need urgent medical attention.
risks: Bleeding, lumps and infection can occur. Rare interruption of blood flow can damage tissue or affect vision.
